title: Serum peptidomic ML signature for early-stage ovarian cancer detection
summary: In 843 participants with an external validation set of 159, early-stage ovarian cancer detection reached specificity 92.6% at 95% sensitivity (AUC 0.993). The PPV of 0.201 comes from a simulated population, not an observed one, and the external set is small.
ai_technology: Biology-informed machine learning feature selection and LightGBM (ProMS+) on serum peptidomics
organization: Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital, Tongji University, China

evidence.tested: 843 participants; external validation n=159; multicentre prospective
evidence.unknown: Simulated PPV is not observed; small external set; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Biology-informed ML feature selection and LightGBM (ProMS+) on serum peptidomics
